Will baby grow up thinking it is part sheep?

posts.body:
My son (he's 28 now !) slept on a lamb fleece from newborn. No problems.

When my daughter was born (she's 15 now) lamb fleeces were classed as a bad thing. Could never work out why although overheating was mentioned. However, she was premature and weighed just over 3lbs when she was born. Guess what they put prem babies on in the neonatal unit ? Yep, lamb fleeces.

Neither of my children eat grass or spend their spare time in a field
